notes: Machine-readable layered-source contract for Reimu Eating Set layered assets v1.

This is consumer-side authoring metadata: tools/build_reimu_animations.py turns it into the inline `source` object of a Sprite Harness Animation Plan v2. It is not a harness schema and must not duplicate one.
Layers must be explicitly authored PNGs under asset_root; never derive them from the flattened base.png by segmentation, thresholding, inpainting, or bbox guessing.
All positions are PROVISIONAL until measured from the authored pilot layers (task_2); update them together with the first committed layer PNGs.

Pilot intake uses full 596x596 RGBA transparent canvases with each part already in final composition coordinates; no cropped layers. Provisional positions are NOT placement instructions for this export policy; calibrate only after real art arrives and before static reconstruction.
Human-facing specification, per-layer ownership, QA checklist: docs/reimu-layered-assets-v1.md.

layers.notes: Ground plane. The tatami must never breathe, bob, or bounce.
Seated torso, legs, skirt, detached sleeves; excludes head, hands, props.
Hair, large red bow, face base. Excludes eyes and mouth so expressions stay discrete.
Tier-specific open eyes (tears, easing, happy arcs per emotional progression).
Blink counterpart of eyes_open; optional until blink is animated for the state.
Tier-specific mouth; chew is a very small local motion or a variant layer.
Far/resting hand; only authored when the state's pose shows it separately.
Low table in front of the seated body. The table ground line never moves.
Tier-specific tabletop meal composition; no drift unless a track is explicitly designed.
Food held by the eating hand (recurring onigiri anchor); shares the hand's motion tracks.
Near eating hand, small local arc between table and mouth; must return naturally on loop.
Steam, sparkles, tears, sweat drop — foreground overlays owned per tier.
